consumer: The frontend inventory panel reading avatar.carried_items[] from the snapshot JSON; it asks 'what items is the player holding top-level?' and SHOWS them.
scope: only the character's own carried items, top-level (wielded/worn/inventory stacks), no recursive container descent
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items iterates ctx.u.wielded_items()/worn/inv_const_slice() top-level stacks and emits display_name/symbol/location per item into carried_items[] for the panel to render.
divergence: A flashlight nested inside a worn backpack is listed as a top-level carried item (recursive descent like visit_internal), so the displayed list shows an item the player is not directly holding.
